messages:
sarah_ng: Heads-up — I'm drafting an SDK pattern doc for mapping Redwood API errors into language-specific exceptions and how to surface the request_id in logs. Wanted quick :eyes: and any gotchas for streaming and retries before I open a PR.

mike_chen: SG. A couple things we always trip on: 1) 429 vs 503 semantics for retries, 2) streaming connection resets that should surface a ResumeableStreamingError, 3) how to attach request_id to logger context so we can tie client logs to server traces.

jonah: For 429 include server `Retry-After` when present. If absent use exponential backoff with jitter. Also prefer typed errors over string matching in consumers.

clara_k: Language note: in Go we return typed errors (wrapped) not exceptions; recommend `IsRetryable(err)` helper. In Node/Python we throw `RetryableError` subclass. For Rust you can use enum variants.

mike_chen: +1. Example mapping I'm thinking:
```
HTTP 401 -> AuthError (no retry)
HTTP 403 -> PermissionError (no retry)
HTTP 429 -> RateLimitError (retry after header)
HTTP 5xx -> TransientError (eligible for retry)
Stream EOF/connection reset -> ResumeableStreamingError (client may reconnect)
```

sarah_ng: Nice. Any opinion on attaching request_id? We're sending `x-request-id` header from the API.

jonah: Propagate `x-request-id` into the SDK logger and expose it on exceptions. e.g. attach `ctx.request_id` and include in error string and structured fields.

clara_k: Quick snippet for Go logging context:
```
ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, "request_id", reqID)
logger.With("request_id", reqID).Error("call failed", "err", err)
```
And for Python raise exception with `request_id` attr.

mike_chen: Also make sure SDK surfaces the raw `Retry-After` when available (seconds or HTTP-date), and include `retryable: true/false` in the error object for easier consumer logic.

sarah_ng: Good point. For streaming, should we include resumable offsets/tokens in the error details when the server supports it?

jonah: Yes include `resume_token` or `last_event_cursor` when possible. That avoids full restart in many clients.

clara_k: Code review ping @mike_chen and @jonah — I'll push a prototype PR to `sdk-core` with types for JS/TS and Go helpers. Want quick review on error shapes and logging fields.

deploy-bot: CI: build passed for branch `sarah/error-patterns` — 4 tests, 2 lint warnings.

mike_chen: I'll review tomorrow morning. If tests are light we can merge and iterate.

sarah_ng: Thanks all — I'll add examples for Node, Go, and a small Rust enum example. Will include a short snippet showing how to extract `request_id` from caught exceptions for error reporting. :thumbsup:
